description:
Salesforce Architect (m/f/d)
 

Ref.-No.: JR1014949



Position Summary

CWS Hygiene is the market leader in sustainable hand and toilet hygiene and one of the driving forces behind a healthier, safer, and more sustainable future. Across Europe, thousands of colleagues work every day to make a difference for our customers, our communities, and the environment.


As our digital landscape continues to evolve, we are investing in the transformation and modernization of our global CRM ecosystem. To support this strategic journey, we are looking for a Salesforce Architect to join our international IT Lead to Quote (LTQ) team.


This role focuses on defining, governing, and evolving our Salesforce platform architecture while supporting the consolidation of multiple Salesforce environments into a unified global solution. You will play a key role in establishing scalable architecture standards, enabling business transformation, and strengthening our internal Salesforce expertise.


This is a hybrid role. We are open to candidates based in Germany or any other EU country where CWS Hygiene has a legal entity. Candidates should be willing to travel occasionally to support workshops, stakeholder meetings, and project-related activities across Europe.


Mission

Customer relationship management is a critical enabler of growth, operational excellence, and customer experience at CWS Hygiene. As Salesforce Architect, you will help shape the future of our Salesforce landscape while supporting a major transformation initiative that aims to consolidate and standardize CRM capabilities across Europe.


You will become the technical authority for Salesforce within the organization. Working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, Enterprise Architects, Key Users, and external implementation partners, you will translate business needs into scalable, secure, and future-proof Salesforce solutions.


What makes this role unique is the combination of strategic ownership, architecture leadership, and transformation impact. You will not simply maintain an existing platform. You will actively define the future Salesforce architecture, support international transformation initiatives, and help build internal capabilities while reducing dependency on external partners.


Key Responsibilities

  • You will take ownership of the Salesforce architecture domain and ensure that platform design decisions support business objectives, scalability, maintainability, and long-term growth.
  • Your work will include defining solution architectures, establishing technical governance, evaluating business requirements, facilitating design discussions, and guiding implementation teams to deliver robust and sustainable Salesforce solutions.
  • You will lead architecture activities related to the consolidation of multiple Salesforce organizations into a single global platform, helping drive standardization and reducing unnecessary complexity.
  • You will define and maintain integration architecture principles connecting Salesforce with ERP, eCommerce, customer service, marketing, and other enterprise platforms.
  • You will establish and promote development standards, architectural best practices, security principles, and governance frameworks while supporting development teams through reviews and technical guidance.
  • You will contribute to platform roadmap planning, release strategies, DevOps maturity, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure a stable and scalable Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You will evaluate emerging Salesforce technologies and capabilities, including Agentforce, Einstein AI, and platform innovations, identifying opportunities to create business value.
  • As our internal Salesforce architecture expert, you will play an important role in strengthening in-house capabilities, driving knowledge sharing, and creating sustainable solutions that support long-term business growth.

Requirements

At CWS Hygiene, we know that technical expertise is only part of the story. We are looking for someone who enjoys collaboration, provides technical leadership, and has a genuine passion for designing solutions that balance business value with architectural excellence.


Ideally, you bring:

  • A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a comparable field.
  • 7+ years of Salesforce experience, including several years in Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Lead Developer, or comparable positions.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions.
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce Platform Architecture, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and integration frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, and modern Salesforce development practices.
  • Experience defining integration architectures using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, middleware, and event-driven approaches.
  • Experience supporting large-scale CRM transformation, migration, or platform consolidation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, sharing models, governance, and quality standards.
  • Experience with CI/CD processes, release management, and Salesforce DevOps practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Fluent English language skills.
  • Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, CTA journey experience, Agentforce knowledge, or experience in international environments are considered an advantage.

What do we offer?

Working at CWS Hygiene means joining an international organization where collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life.


You will become part of a supportive environment where people are encouraged to learn, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. We offer the opportunity to work with modern Salesforce technologies, collaborate with colleagues across Europe, and make a visible impact on one of the company's most important CRM transformation initiatives.


In addition, we offer an attractive compensation package with a competitive base salary, depending on your country of residence and relevant experience. We also offer flexible working arrangements, modern IT equipment, and a culture that values both personal and professional development.


About CWS Hygiene 

With innovative, sustainable, and digitalized service solutions, CWS Hygiene ensures health, safety, and protection in the workplace and in public spaces.


The complete solutions include hand and washroom hygiene for small to large sanitary facilities as well as clean entrances and exits with mats in building complexes, public buildings, and industrial facilities. CWS Hygiene

stands for sustainability: thanks to its rental model, the company offers its customers a so-called "circular economy," thereby contributing to a healthier and safer future. More than 65,000 existing customers in Germany are supported by over 1,500 employees, with a total workforce of 4,000 across Europe. 


CWS Hygiene operates in 15 European countries and is owned by Franz Haniel & Cie. GmbH.
